steps.description: 准备 tmux 持久命令终端；它不承载正式服务。

arguments.command:
entry="$PREFIX/bin/openhouse-control-plane-start"; implementation="$PREFIX/libexec/openhouse/start-service-manager.sh"; if [ -x "$entry" ]; then printf 'control_plane_entry=ok
'; else printf 'control_plane_entry=missing
'; fi; if [ -x "$implementation" ]; then printf 'control_plane_implementation=ok
'; else printf 'control_plane_implementation=missing
'; fi; printf 'SVDIR=%s
LOGDIR=%s
' "${SVDIR:-$PREFIX/var/service}" "${LOGDIR:-$PREFIX/var/log}"; SVDIR="${SVDIR:-$PREFIX/var/service}" sv status service-manager || true; curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:20087/api/v1/health || true

steps.description: 只读诊断两个固定脚本、runit 状态和无鉴权 health；不得因为 yuanshengwuxianpi stopped 而判定 service-manager 损坏。
检查 service-daemon、runsvdir、sv status service-manager 和 20087；忽略 WuxianPi 的正常 stopped 状态。
